messages:
Alex: Quick preflight for my evening shift — taking over in ~10m. Short notes so nobody has to dig: 

Alex: Current pool snapshot (last 5m): eu-west-1 72% GPU util, us-east-1 61%, ap-southeast-2 49%. Overall headroom ~18% across reserved pools.

Alex: Known-ish risks:
- AcmeLabs spike still sending long-context reranks; KV cache pressure up (KV hitrate ~78% on eu-west).
- EduBuddy scheduled embedding job @22:00 UTC (batching large files) — expect a ~10–15% bump in token throughput for ~20m.

Alex: Quick ops checks I ran: 
```
# check pool health
rwdctl pool status --region eu-west-1 --format short
kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide --namespace rwd-prod
```

Alex: Actions I'm taking before I leave handoff:
- Set a temporary alert: pool_utilization > 85% for 3m -> page oncall. (alert id: rwd-alert-3321)
- Bumped autoscale policy for eu-west to `burst-friendly` (will revert if no spike).
- Pushed a soft rate-limit on AcmeLabs /rerank route to 120rps via console (10% throttle window).

Alex: Can someone please cover 23:00–00:30 UTC? I'm on call until 23:15 only. If not, I'll stay later but would like to hand off. @maria @jon @sam

Maria: I can take 23:00–00:00 UTC. Happy to extend if big traffic. :+1:

Jon: I can cover 00:00–00:30 if needed. Thx for the preflight.

Sam: FYI — infra scheduled a non-disruptive maintenance window for a subset of reserved nodes 23:45–00:15 UTC (rolling). Should be fine but might reduce burst headroom briefly.

infra-bot: [notice] maintenance scheduled: reserved-gpu-pool-eu-west nodes 3/12 rolling 2026-12-10T23:45Z -> 2026-12-11T00:15Z. Impact: possible temporary reduced burst capacity.

Jon: Thanks for the heads-up. I'll keep the aggressive fallback model ready (llama-13b-low-latency) in case of capacity pressure.

Alex: Good call. Jon — if you flip fallback, set route-level fallback to `llama-13b-ql` (lower mem) and keep `max_seq_len` at 2048 for the canary.

Maria: One quick note on KV metrics: if hitrate drops under 70% and latency >300ms for 3 consecutive mins, escalate to infra-sre and we'll consider temporary cache warming.

Sam: I'll monitor embed job at 22:00. If it looks noisy, I can dial back batch size from 1024 -> 512 and re-route non-critical batches to low-priority queue.

Alex: Thanks team. Dashboard links: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/pool-eu-west and https://console.redwood.ai/dash/alerts/rwd-alert-3321

Alex: Leaving a few sticky bits in case I get pulled away:
- If AcmeLabs still spikes after throttle, drop them to 80rps and notify customer-svc to coordinate.
- If pool_utilization > 90% for 2m, flip fallback and increase concurrency limit on dedicated nodes by +2 (if available).

Maria: noted. I'll take first alert.

Jon: I'll standby for fallback flip.

Alex: Cheers — handing over now. Ping in thread if anything changes. :coffee:
